subject.title: fix(deepinfra): use OpenAI video end point and tag DeepSeek thinking format

question: Should a shipped DeepInfra `nativeBaseUrl` continue targeting the native inference API, or may upgrades reinterpret it as an OpenAI-compatible videos base?
rationale: Both contracts cannot be inferred safely from the same configured URL, and choosing between backward compatibility and retiring the native route changes existing operator behavior.

options.title: Preserve native semantics
options.body: Keep `nativeBaseUrl` on the existing native inference path and use `baseUrl` for `/v1/openai/videos`, with regression coverage for both configurations.

options.title: Retire through migration
options.body: Define `baseUrl` as the only runtime contract and add a plugin-owned doctor migration that converts only configurations whose destination can be migrated safely.

options.title: Accept the breaking remap
options.body: Land the reinterpretation as an intentional compatibility break with explicit upgrade documentation and proof for affected custom endpoints.

recommendation.title: Preserve native semantics
recommendation.body: Keep `nativeBaseUrl` on the existing native inference path and use `baseUrl` for `/v1/openai/videos`, with regression coverage for both configurations.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate for the provider compatibility policy and were directly brought into the current review thread.
